name: Tovex-ERP
description: Industrial manufacturing ERP suite — React 19 + WebGL/three.js GLSL shaders, 12-role RBAC, front-end-only demo

paragraphs: Industrial ERP suite for a steel and heavy-fabrication plant — front-end only.

Every screen works, every role sees a personalised experience, and all data flows from a single in-memory source of truth. The visual layer is built on WebGL — three.js with custom GLSL shaders — for a "rendered, not drawn" control-room feel.

No backend and no login. The app boots into a first-run setup wizard (create company → set brand → add or import members) and then straight into the dashboard. Operational data is seeded in memory; company, members, modules, and permission overrides persist locally.
features: Live theming. A dark control-room theme with a molten-orange accent as the single source of truth. Change it in Company Settings and the whole app re-themes live — both the CSS variables and the shader's uAccent uniform.
12 roles with RBAC. A header role switcher re-personalises the dashboard, sidebar, calendar focus, and write permissions. The permission matrix is editable under Access Control.
First-run setup wizard. Company profile, brand accent, and team members added manually or imported from an Excel/CSV file (template included).

Operations. Customers, sales leads, quotations, products, inventory, purchase orders, vendors, production orders, quality reports, machines, maintenance, projects, and tasks — each a full CRUD list with search,…

Admin layer. A document engine (PR, RFQ, PO, WO, BOM, Invoice, and more) with an approvals trail, an append-only audit log, a module manager that enables and renames modules live, plus departments, employees, and a…

whatItDoes.text: Industrial ERP suite for a steel and heavy-fabrication plant — front-end only.
